title: DeLonge's meetings at the Pentagon and NASA

tellings.quote: A bunch of meetings start. So he's flown out to the Pentagon where he meets with someone and they say, "Okay, now you're going to NASA." Where he meets with some people. I think arguably you could say maybe Pete Worden who's a one-star NASA general may have been there.

plain: Around 2015 and 2016, a man named DeLonge, who was pushing to bring UFO stories to the public, was flown to the Pentagon (the US military headquarters), met someone there, and was then told, "Okay, now you're going to NASA," the US space agency, where he met more people. The researcher Jason Simosa tells this without naming a source, and he guesses that Pete Worden, whom he calls a one-star general at NASA, "may have been there." He tells it to show that officials took DeLonge seriously enough to send him from one agency to the next.
